SkinBeautySettingsCN.description: One shared panel for skin-tone correction presets and fine controls.

预设.name: Preset
预设.tooltip: Choose a starting preset; changing a slider switches to Custom.

总强度.name: Intensity
总强度.tooltip: Overall blend between the original and corrected skin.

美白.name: Whitening
美白.tooltip: Raises skin lightness while highlight protection limits clipping.

冷暖.name: Cool / Warm
冷暖.tooltip: Positive values reduce yellow and cool the skin; negative values warm it.

红润.name: Rosy Tone
红润.tooltip: Adds or removes a restrained red/rosy component.

匀肤.name: Evenness
匀肤.tooltip: Balances local skin luminance and chroma differences.

暗部提亮.name: Shadow Lift
暗部提亮.tooltip: Raises darker skin regions more than highlights.

高光保护.name: Highlight Protection
高光保护.tooltip: Protects bright forehead, nose, and cheek highlights.

平滑.name: Smoothing
平滑.tooltip: Applies restrained local smoothing inside the skin mask.

纹理保留.name: Texture Preservation
纹理保留.tooltip: Preserves pores, fine hair, and local detail.

肤色识别.name: Skin Detection
肤色识别.tooltip: Controls the coverage of the adaptive skin-color probability mask.

蒙版羽化.name: Mask Feather
蒙版羽化.tooltip: Softens transitions between selected skin and surrounding areas.

0.name: Beauty Settings
0.tooltip: Configuration shared with one or more processor nodes.

1.name: Settings Summary
1.tooltip: Bilingual summary of the effective settings.

SkinBeautyProcessorCN.description: Corrects detected skin, supports batches and external masks, and keeps full-resolution IMAGE outputs.

图像.name: Image
图像.tooltip: ComfyUI IMAGE input; same-size batches are supported.

美白参数.name: Beauty Settings
美白参数.tooltip: Connect the Skin Beauty settings node.

蒙版模式.name: Mask Mode
蒙版模式.tooltip: Choose automatic skin selection, external-mask fusion, external-only, or full-frame grading.

语义蒙版.name: Semantic Mask
语义蒙版.tooltip: Automatic mode never downloads. The explicit download mode downloads only the pinned model and never installs Python packages.

options.MediaPipe：允许首次下载: MediaPipe: allow model download only; never installs Python packages

批处理.name: Batch Processing
批处理.tooltip: Sequential mode reduces peak memory; parallel mode is for small same-size batches.

计算设备.name: Compute Device
计算设备.tooltip: Auto chooses a suitable device and can fall back after CUDA out-of-memory.

生成节点预览.name: Generate Node Preview
生成节点预览.tooltip: Creates a temporary UI-only PNG; formal IMAGE outputs remain full resolution.

实时精确预览.name: Live Exact Preview
实时精确预览.tooltip: Refreshes the real backend preview after controls remain idle for about 0.5 seconds.

外部遮罩.name: External Mask
外部遮罩.tooltip: Optional MASK input; external-mask-only is the highest-precision path.

0.name: Corrected Image
0.tooltip: Full-resolution IMAGE output with original batch and extra channels preserved.

1.name: Skin Mask
1.tooltip: BHW skin mask used by the correction pipeline.

2.name: Preview Image
2.tooltip: Full-resolution IMAGE output; only the embedded UI thumbnail is resized.

3.name: Processing Report
3.tooltip: Bilingual processing, mask, device, and fallback report.
